data.title: 塔露拉 · 暖光卧室双人床深红吊带的枕边私语
data.description: 温馨卧室的松软双人床上，塔露拉仅身穿一袭极薄的深红丝绸吊带睡裙侧卧在雪白枕褥间。极细的肩带滑落至臂弯，胸前黑色蕾丝领口随着平复的心跳微微起伏。她一手轻攥着被单边缘，龙角抵着你的指尖，在床头暖灯下流露出毫无防备的全然交付。
data.location: 暖色调私密寝室双人大床软枕间
data.action: 侧卧松软枕间，吊带滑落臂弯，一手攥被单，眼神迷离微喘凝视
data.lighting: 床头暖色小台灯泛出的朦胧昏黄柔光
data.promptProse: Lying on her side amid soft white pillows on a wide wooden bed late at night, Talulah wears a thin deep-crimson silk chemise trimmed with black lace whose slender strap has slipped partway down her arm. Her fingers curl gently into the rumpled bedsheet as her tail rests across the mattress and she looks up toward the viewer with parted lips and a warm, vulnerable blush. Soft amber bedside lamplight warms her bare collarbone and the sheen of crimson silk.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side amid white pillows in a black-lace-trimmed crimson silk chemise with one strap slipped off her arm, Talulah grips the sheet edge and gazes up with parted lips and flushed cheeks. Soft bedside lamplight warms her bare collarbone and silk folds.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a minimal deep-crimson silk chemise trimmed with black lace along the sweetheart neckline, one spaghetti strap slipped down her arm to bare her shoulder, collarbone, and cleavage.
